text:
morgan: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's auth incident. Short summary: missing token expiry enforcement + secrets-rotation lag caused stale tokens to be accepted by some services. I sketched a remediation checklist; need owners for: audit logging gaps, RBAC tighten, secrets rotation automation. @samir @anya can you pick owners?

samir: I can take audit logging gaps. Will triage ELK -> s3 retention and missing event types today.

dina: I'll pair with @samir on the queries. Found 2 services not emitting token_validation failure events to the audit pipeline.

samir: noted. initial checklist for audit logging owner:
- add token_validation failures to audit schema
- ensure logs reach s3 and kinesis w/ 90d retention
- alert on missing events
I'll open PR for the ETL mapping by EOD.

anya: I can own RBAC tighten + perms review. Plan: run role-binding diff against last week's baseline, identify overly broad roles, propose least-priv changes. ETA: end of week. Will post a list for review.

ops_lead: I'll take secrets rotation automation and runbook updates. Proposing weekly rotation job + synthetic validation after rotate. Also we should change default rotation policy from 'manual' -> 'auto' for service accounts in non-prod. :gear: 

morgan: Two additional asks: 1) set up a recurring 6-week pattern check in postmortem tracker (we're seeing recurrence) 2) add a post-deploy audit validation to CI.

samir: for the recurrence check, I'll add a query to surface similar incidents in the last 6 months and push results to the remediation board.

incident-bot: created task INC-4312 and assigned to samir, anya, ops_lead. link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4312

dina: small remediation note — until ETL change lands, add a temporary log-forwarder on the two affected services: `kubectl apply -f log-forwarder-temp.yaml` and set env LOG_AUDIT=true

anya: I'll draft the RBAC PR and include a migration plan for any impacted services. tagging @morgan for rollout window approval.

morgan: ack. prefer rollout low-traffic window Tues 03:00 UTC. Also add a canary check to failback to previous roles if errors spike >1%.

ops_lead: scheduling runbook update and canary steps. Will also add an automated smoke test: request token, validate rejection for expired token.

samir: putting explicit owners & ETA into the tracker now. Action items summarized in INC-4312:
- Samir: audit ETL + alerts (PR by EOD)
- Anya: RBAC tighten + PR (EOW)
- Ops_lead: secrets rotation automation + runbook (next Tue)
- Dina: temp forwarder + validation (today)

morgan: thanks all. Let's have a quick 15m sync tomorrow to confirm PRs and rollout windows. :thumbsup: 

anya: +1

samir: +1

incident-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC (thread INC-4312)
